modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Perform calibration of measuring and testing equipment

pcs.pc_description: receive the measuring and testing equipment from vendors safely and ensure that they are validated and calibrated
prepare plan for the calibration, verification and validation of all the testing and measuring equipment as per the drawing and standards
select standard instruments to be used for measurement based on the range, precision levels and any limitations of profile of the equipment parts
conduct Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA) and Repeatability and Reproducibility (R&R) studies for all the measuring equipment to analyze the variation in measurement of equipment
inspect the details of dimensions, marking, material etc. as per the drawing by using higher accuracy methods for the specified range
review MSA and R&R readings, inspection reports and discard/ repair the measuring equipment which does not adhere to the required specification
discuss with the team and ensure that the countermeasures for equipment having R&R outside the acceptable range are implemented

modules.module_title: Perform audit of product and process

pcs.pc_description: prepare annual plan for process and product audit and execute it on time
use appropriate validation techniques for audit of the regular and new parts and processes
resolve non-conformities identified in validation by discussion with manufacturing process owners and then correct or re-verify/re-validate the parts and processes
report to the senior management about issues and seek support/feedback from them as per the requirements

modules.module_title: Layout inspection by conventional method or 3D CMM(Coordinate Measuring Machine)

pcs.pc_description: select appropriate first principle method for verification of dimensions, profiles, parameters like surface finish, GD&T parameters e.g. roundness, concentricity etc., CMM, gauges like bore/air/ dial, slip gauges, etc., machine/fixture parameters in situ and mounted condition
conduct layout inspection of parts and processes as per the WI/SOP
observe, analyze and co-relate the inspection results/defects with part results
coordinate with the process owners for discussing the counter measures for rectification of defects and re-inspection
coordinate with NPD department and prepare the schedule for gauge verification/validation based on the requirements of the gauge
inspect and validate the gauges/jigs as per the drawing and confirms that fit and tolerance, function usage are within the specified range or not
maintain and update the records of inspection and validation process done as per SOP
